body: Monday morning: two workers from the seed trial carried an oily film. my eyes began burning before the county van arrived.
title: Monday morning — an oily film
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same an oily film while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

body:
We thought he had fallen asleep and left him on the couch. A man at the door asked us to write down when we had last spoken to him.

He wanted one time for all of us. We disagreed because some of us had left the room. He wrote down his own time and asked us to sign below it.

I still have the bottle cap he put beside the paper to hold it flat. I do not know whose account that paper is supposed to be.
title: After the music stopped
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
